name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak passed 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths; Africa CDC says it is still not under control
state: Africa CDC's director-general said on 15 Nov that government data show more than 11,200 infections and 5,500 deaths, that over 80% of new cases come from outside contact lists and over 65% of deaths occur in the community (Gulf Today, 17 Nov; Al Jazeera). About $2.9bn has been pledged and he urged donors to release $1.6bn. Conflict is hampering the response (Africanews, 12 Nov). Cases far exceed the 1,000 Alert line.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice and NaTHNaC guidance for DR Congo. The UKHSA rates the risk to the UK public as very low.

sources.title: Gulf Today — Africa CDC says Ebola outbreak still out of control six months on
Al Jazeera — Africa CDC says Ebola outbreak in DR Congo still not under control
Africanews — DR Congo Ebola outbreak surpasses 11,000 cases as conflict hampers response

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
